summary.text: Democrat Aaron Ford is Nevada's Attorney General and won the election for governor on November 3, 2026, defeating Joe Lombardo, according to unofficial results.
A former public school math teacher, he was elected to the state Senate in 2012, finishing as majority leader, before becoming the state's first Black attorney general in 2019.

paragraphs.text: Ford was raised in a working-class family and earned five degrees, including a Ph.D. in education and a law degree.
He worked as a public school math teacher and for a personal injury law firm in Las Vegas.
He was elected to the Nevada Senate in 2012 and served as Senate Majority Leader.
Ford has served as attorney general since 2019, becoming the first Black attorney general in Nevada history.
During the campaign, his platform centered on housing costs, health care, energy and education, and he supported repealing the state's right-to-work law.
He won the November 3, 2026 general election for Governor of Nevada with 51.6% of the vote to Joe Lombardo's 44.0% and Danielle Ford's 2.9%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
